description: Every form on a page with its action, method and fields (name, type, label, required, options), so an agent knows what a page asks for before interacting. Read only: nothing is submitted. Body: {url}. — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "list the forms on this page", "what does this page ask for", "form fields of this URL".
name: web_forms
